newsitem.title: UK: Prince Charles's son spurns holiday with father - paper.
newsitem.headline: Prince Charles's son spurns holiday with father - paper.

text.p: The 14-year-old son of heir to the throne Prince Charles has turned down the chance to join his father for a post-Christmas skiing holiday in the fashionable Swiss report of Klosters, a newspaper reported on Saturday.
The tabloid Sun said Prince William planned to stay instead with his grandmother Queen Elizabeth on her private estate at Sandringham in the flat, seldom snowy, eastern English county of Norfolk.
The paper said there had been no rift between Charles and his son.
But William did not want to face the pack of journalists and photographers who habitually arrive in Klosters to chronicle his father's annual visits.
It said he had enough media attention when he joined his mother, Princess Diana, whom Charles divorced this year, and his aunt, the Duchess of York, on a holiday on the French riviera in July.
"William just does not want to spend a holiday in the spotlight," the Sun quoted an unnamed source as saying.
The Royal party heading for Switzerland will now comprise Charles, his younger son Prince Harry, 12, friends Charles and Patti Palmer Tomkinson and an aide, it said.
No one was immediately available at Buckingham Palace to comment on the Sun's story.
